Great question — using it consistently and correctly is what helps people get the most out of Nurosym. 
Simple daily routine:
Apply a bit of moisture to the tragus (front part of your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, cable over and behind the ear.
Turn it on and slowly increase intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling.
Use for 15–60 minutes per session, ideally 30–60 minutes daily.  
Best timing:
Morning after waking, or
Split into morning + evening (before sleep). 
You can use it while reading, working, meditating, or relaxing — it’s designed to fit into normal activities.
Tip: keep the sensation comfortable. Higher intensity doesn’t mean better — it should always feel pleasant.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s best to speak with our clinical team before starting.
